title: Many at OpenAI and DeepMind, and many experts, disagree with the AI doom warnings - TCR 09/20/26
description:
Anonymous staff at OpenAI, Meta, and DeepMind told the BBC the AI extinction warnings are implausible, the White House announced an "AI Force" and an AI czar days after calling the danger a hoax, and an Anthropic engineer said Claude factored RSA-896, a 270-digit encryption challenge, across 2,048 idle GPUs.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-september-20-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
0:55 Insiders and scientists answer AI's doom warnings
4:20 A federal AI Force and czar appear
7:08 Claude factors RSA-896 on idle GPUs
10:23 A free model reads 146 findings from one scan
13:47 Close

This episode covers the insider and scientific pushback against AI doom, the American left's split over present versus future harm, the White House AI Force and the nationalize-or-accelerate industry clash, California's developing verified-shutdown requirements, Alibaba's free RADAR model outperforming 23 of 26 radiologists in a reader study across 146 diseases, and a NATO-backed drone selecting its own target on edge hardware.

A counter-current to the week's extinction warnings crystallized, and it started from inside the labs sounding them. Anonymous engineers at OpenAI, Meta, and DeepMind told the BBC the doom framing stays vague where a concrete pathway should be, scientists explained that physical lab work can be a key bottleneck in engineering a plague, and a viral self-replicating-bot scare was unsupported by public evidence. The American left split over whether alarmism distracts from present harms, while SAG-AFTRA and the WGA pointed to the enforceable AI protections they already hold. The White House answered the alarm by naming an AI czar and an "AI Force" with almost no detail, as Jensen Huang, Alex Karp, and Huawei's chair gave three incompatible answers. Underneath the noise, three kinds of scarce expertise collapsed in the same cycle: Claude factored the 270-digit RSA-896 across 2,048 idle GPUs, Alibaba's free RADAR model out-read 23 of 26 radiologists across 146 diseases, and a NATO-backed drone chose its own target on edge hardware. Every credible check on that power is coming from outside the offices claiming authority over it.
